items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 37:1
items.html: (To the question) In the third aspect of the posterior, and only in the Mochin of YESHSUT, which are discerned as the illumination of the head from above downward.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 38:1
items.html: (To the question) Because the Nukva receives them only by the bowing of the head of ZA down to his chest and below. See above, Answer 31.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 39:1
items.html: There is a difference between the MAN of the male and the MAN of the Nukva: for the MAN of the male are only from the aspect of the inclusion of Malchut in him, namely the aspect of Benjamin included in Joseph, for he himself is the aspect of the upper nine, and not the aspect of Malchut and Nukva. But the MAN of the Nukva are from her own aspect, namely only from Malchut. And for this reason, Malchut cannot receive the Mochin of the AB of the Ima of the Mazal, except only when she is in the back, namely without a coupling with ZA, for they are the aspect of male MAN, since there is no aspect of Malchut itself in the MAN of the Dikna, but only the aspect of the Yesod of Malchut, for the Mazal VeNotzer is only the aspect of the Yesod of the Dikna, as is known. Therefore she is not fit to couple with ZA, for she has no aspect of her own MAN. Hence she returns to the point and comes in the Ibur, Yenika, and Mochin of face to face, which emerge upon the Malchut of Ima that is clothed in the head of ZA, as is known; then she has feminine MAN and is fit to couple with ZA. However, she is discerned in this as needing ZA, and she receives from him, and they are not equal in a single Keter.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 39:2
items.html: (To the question) And it is found that therefore she cannot stand in the Mochin of the posterior so as to be equal with him in a single Keter, because her Malchut is below the Yesod of ZA — that is, she lacks the aspect of the Malchut of the first restriction, as it is found in the Yesod of ZA, for in the Yesod of ZA is found the aspect of the male MAN of the first restriction, as above. And she would need to be in the aspect of feminine MAN also in her Yesod, namely the aspect of the Malchut of the first restriction; then they would not need each other, but would couple face to face in a single equal Keter. However, since the Malchut in her has no counterpart opposite it, because she is below his Yesod — that is, she cannot couple with his Yesod, since her root is hidden in RADLA, and all the aspect of her MAN is drawn only from the Malchut of Ima, which is the second restriction — but out of the inclusion that this Malchut of Ima receives from the crown of Gevura of ZA, there is in her a power of the illumination of the GAR, as above; then she can receive the aspect of the coupling of the GAR of souls from ZA. Behold, she needs him, and she is smaller than him, and cannot serve with him in a single Keter, as above. (Item 13).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 40:1
items.html: (To the question) For she could not stand in the Mochin of the posterior, as above in Answer 7; therefore she returned to the aspect of the ascent of MAN, for the sake of the Ibur of the Mochin of the front. And therefore she is discerned as having remained below again in the aspect of a point, for the upper nine ascended to ZA in the secret of MAN. For this is the rule: at the time of the ascent of MAN, only the aspect of the addition ascends, but what the Partzuf has from the aspect of permanence does not ascend as MAN, as above in Part 1, Page 735, Item 94; Part 1, Page 785, Item 184.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 41:1
items.html: (To the question) The upper nine that departed in the secret of the diminishment of the moon are the aspect of the ascent of MAN, for the sake of the Mochin of the front, as above in Answer 170. But the matter of the upper nine that departed because of the sin of Adam HaRishon was due to a flaw: by the sin, the sparks of his soul fell into the Klipot; and because of this, also the MAN that he left above in ZON, in the aspect of standing and sustenance for their Mochin, also fell from there. Therefore the Mochin also departed, and the sparks and the vessels fell into the Klipot, as above in Answer 65, see there. (Item 22).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 42:1
items.html: (To the question) For these Mochin of the posterior come only by the inclusion of the Hod of AA in his Netzach, as above in Answer 6, when the Nukva Rachel became like the aspect of the Nukva in the body of ZA, namely the aspect of the Malchut of Netzach, see there. Therefore the diminishment of the moon was on the fourth day, which is Netzach. (Item 18).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 43:1
items.html: (To the question) In the third aspect of the posterior, but not from the stature of Aba and Ima, only from the stature of YESHSUT, which are discerned as the illumination of the head from above downward. (Items 12 and 18).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 44:1
items.html: (To the question) See Answer 7.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 45:1
items.html: (To the question) For ZA has no Mochin of Chaya unless he ascends for Ibur to the GAR of AA — that is, Aba and Ima are in the place of the GAR of Atik, and their belly, which is YESHSUT, is in the place of the GAR of AA — when she receives the stature of his Mochin from AA in the aspect of neither upright nor bowed, as above, Part 14, Item 193 and Answer 79, see there. However, on weekdays, when the Mochin come from the bowing of the head of AA downward, to the place of the Aba and Ima of AB, this suffices only for the aspect of Jacob, who is the aspect of the Achoraim of Aba and Ima, and does not need to receive from the aspect of Atik, who is the Keter of Atzilut, for Aba and Ima have a hold only on AB, as said there in the Inner Light, see there. Therefore ZA needs to bow his head, with the Mochin he received from YESHSUT, down to the place of the standing of Jacob, namely from the chest and below, which then ascends to the place of the HGT, so that Jacob receives these Mochin of Neshama of ZA, which suffice for him for the Mochin of Chaya and for the birth; and he is the one who bestows them to the Nukva and couples with her face to face. See well in the above Inner Light. (Item 23).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 46:1
items.html: (To the question) For all the Mochin of face to face come to her in the aspect of an offshoot of the Mochin of ZA, namely by the inclusion of the Malchut of Ima in his crown of Gevura. Therefore, although she ascends with him up to the Keter of Aba and Ima, nevertheless, since all this ascent comes to her by means of ZA, she is smaller than him, and his Keter is discerned as greater than her Keter.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 47:1
items.html: (To the question) After the seven lower of the Nukva were included in her GAR, nothing remained in her but the aspect of Nefesh alone. (Item 28).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 48:1
items.html: (To the question) For the Mochin of ZA are drawn from the AB that is upon the Mazal, which is the aspect of the first restriction and harsh Din; but when they are in the place of the coupling in the head, they are sweetened. However, in his NHY, which are the ten Sefirot of the end, the Dinim are found revealed there, as above in Answer 35.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 49:1
items.html: (To the question) See above in Answer 92.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 50:1
items.html: (To the question) See above in Answer 92.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 51:1
items.html: (To the question) See above in Answer 35.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 52:1
items.html: (To the question) See above in Answer 7.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 53:1
items.html: (To the question) Before the First Temple, the Nukva was in the third aspect, back to back, of the Mochin of YESHSUT, which are the aspect of the illumination of the head from above downward. And ZA was in the Mochin of the Gadlut of Neshama alone; therefore they are discerned with him only as the aspect of VAK of Gadlut, clothed in his KHB HGT, and his NHY were then found empty of light. Behold, Ima spread in him only the first Hod alone, namely in the old Hod that became Gevura, and in his NHY Ima did not spread. As above. (Item 40).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 54:1
items.html: (To the question) For it is impossible for the Nukva to serve with ZA in a single Keter, except at the time when Malchut is revealed in RADLA, in the secret of the cornerstone, as above in Answer 7. This is the aspect of the end of correction, when death will be swallowed up forever. And it is found that if it had been so in the First Temple, surely no nation or tongue would have ruled over it, for after the end of correction the Klipot are nullified forever. (Item 38).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 55:1
items.html: (To the question) For the Mochin of ZA come only from the aspect of his Daat, upon the coupling of which the ten Sefirot of his head emerge up to the Keter. Therefore his Daat is discerned as the aspect of Keter, for the Daat is what draws it. (Item 40).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 56:1
items.html: (To the question) The seventh aspect, which is the matter of both of them using a single Keter, means a coupling, for using means a coupling; and this is only face to face, for there is no coupling but face to face. Therefore, on Shabbat Mincha, when the Nukva is in the Mochin of face to face, the Nukva cannot ascend with ZA to the GAR of AA, namely to the aspect of Yechida and to use a single Keter, because she has no aspect of the MAN of the first restriction, as in Answer 7. Not so at Neila of Yom Kippur, when the Nukva is back to back — meaning she is without a coupling — she can ascend in an equal stature with ZA up to his Keter, namely to the aspect of Yechida. See Answer 7.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 57:1
items.html: (To the question) The matter of the departure of the upper nine of the Nukva at the time of the destruction of the First Temple was not due to a flaw; for were it due to a flaw, she would not have returned to be built with them immediately, in the aspect of back to back from the chest and below, with the illumination of the head in them, which is the third aspect of the posterior, as they were before the building of the Temple. And what was flawed there, because of the sin of the generation — namely the illumination of the seven lower of Bina, which is all the building of face to face of the sixth aspect — this did not depart from ZA, but fell into the Klipot, as the Rav wrote. (Item 43 and in the Inner Light there, s.v. however).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 58:1
items.html: (To the question) Only the aspect of the Mochin of the GAR of the sixth aspect was flawed, but the aspects of the Ibur, Yenika, and Mochin of the posterior were not flawed; therefore she returned and was built from them immediately after the destruction. (Item 45).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:1
items.html: The first state is when she is a point below the Yesod of ZA.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:2
items.html: The second state, on the fourth day of the days of creation, when she was in the third aspect of the aspects of the Mochin of the posterior of YESHSUT, which are the illumination of the head from above downward; then was the diminishment of the moon.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:3
items.html: The third state, after the diminishment of the moon, when she returned to a point, and her upper nine ascended to ZA.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:4
items.html: The fourth state, on the sixth day of the days of creation, when she returned and grew to the third aspect of the aspects of the Mochin of the posterior of YESHSUT.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:5
items.html: The fifth state, the coupling of ZON for the birth of Adam HaRishon in the Hall of Aba and Ima. And had Adam HaRishon not sinned, ZON would have coupled afterward in this aspect.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:6
items.html: The sixth state, after the sin of Adam HaRishon, when the Nukva returned to a point, and her lower nine fell into the Klipot.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:7
items.html: The seventh state, when she returned and was corrected in the sixth aspect, which is face to face, from the Mochin of Aba and Ima.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:8
items.html: The eighth state, on the first day after the Sabbath of creation, when the Nukva returned to the aspect of back to back from the chest and below, without the illumination of the head, which is the aspect of VAK lacking GAR entirely, namely VAK of Ruach. They are attached back to back in a single wall.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:9
items.html: The ninth state is what was changed by the sin of the seven generations, which raised her above the seven firmaments, and her seven lower, which rose to her GAR — that is, the aspect of three within three — are found, and nothing remained but the aspect of Nefesh.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:10
items.html: The tenth state is at the time of the seven righteous, from Abraham to Moses, when they returned and lowered her as she was before the departure, namely to back to back from the chest and below, and both are attached in a single wall, without the illumination of the head.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:11
items.html: The eleventh state is on the tenth of the month, when the Nukva was back to back from the chest and below, namely as in the tenth state above, except that by the taking of the Paschal offering, when the days of the examination began, the illuminations of the head began to shine in her.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:12
items.html: The twelfth state is on the fifteenth of the month, on the night of Passover, when, by this — having received the illuminations of the head of ZA, from the aspect of the Mochin of Aba and Ima — she returned face to face, in the sixth aspect.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:13
items.html: The thirteenth state is after the first night of Passover, when she immediately returned to the point of back to back, but in the third aspect of the posterior, from the Mochin of YESHSUT, namely back to back, with the illumination of the head from above downward. And this continued until the building of the First Temple, except on the Shabbats, when she returned to the sixth aspect.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:14
items.html: The fourteenth state is at the time of the First Temple, when she returned to the sixth aspect, which is face to face in an equal stature, from the aspect of the Mochin of Aba and Ima; and this was corrected in her permanently, even on weekdays. And nothing was lacking to her except this seventh degree, for had she attained it, no nation or tongue would have been able to rule over us anymore.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:15
items.html: The fifteenth state is at the moment of the destruction of the First Temple, when she returned to a point below the Yesod; had this not been, the Klipot and the nations of the world would not have had the ability to destroy the Temple. And then her upper nine ascended to ZA, and did not descend to the Klipot.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:16
items.html: The sixteenth state is immediately after the destruction, when she returned to be a complete Partzuf from the chest and below, with the illumination of the head, which is the third aspect of back to back, from the Mochin of YESHSUT, as she was before the building of the First Temple. And this continued until the building of the Second Temple.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:17
items.html: The seventeenth state is in the Second Temple, when she was corrected permanently in the third aspect of face to face, from the Mochin of YESHSUT, which is the fifth of the seven aspects, namely face to face from the chest and below, with the illumination of the head from above downward. This is the secret of what was lacking there — five things, namely the aspect of the clothing of the illuminations of the head of ZA in their place, which is the sixth aspect, as it was in the First Temple permanently; this was lacking to her in the Second Temple, for she had only the fifth aspect. Except on the Shabbats, when she had the sixth aspect.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:18
items.html: The eighteenth state is at the destruction of the Second Temple, when, by the destruction, she returned to the aspect of a point, and her lower nine fell into the Klipot. This resembles the state after the sin of Adam HaRishon, except that the difference is: there it caused the correction of the Klipot, for before his sin the Klipot had no correction; but at the time of the destruction, the Klipot had already been corrected; rather, they caused the holiness to return and clothe within the Klipa.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:19
items.html: The nineteenth state is at the time of the exile after the Second Temple, when, by the prayer, she is raised up to the fifth aspect, which is face to face from the chest and below, with the illumination of the head from above downward. But outside the time of prayer, she is in the aspect of a point below the Yesod. And this is on weekdays.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:20
items.html: (To the question) The twentieth state is on the Shabbats at the time of the exile, when, at the time of the Musaf prayer, she is raised to the sixth aspect, which clothes the illuminations of the head of ZA in their place; they are the aspect of face to face in an equal stature, from the Mochin of Aba and Ima. (Items 15 to 55).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 60:1
items.html: (To the question) On the Shabbats, although the Nukva ascends with ZA up to the Keter of Aba and Ima, nevertheless they do not use a single Keter, for the Nukva needs the illumination of the Mochin of ZA, and the NHY of ZA clothe in her; therefore she is smaller than him, and his Keter is greater than her Keter. But on Rosh Chodesh and Yom Tov, the inclusion of the Hod of AA in his Netzach is made, and the Nukva is included in the Netzach of AA, like ZA, and she can receive the Mochin of the Aba and Ima of the AB of the Mazal, equally with ZA; then she no longer needs ZA, for just as ZA receives from Aba, so the Nukva receives from Ima. Therefore both of them are equal in a single Keter. (Items 57 and 58).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 61:1
items.html: (To the question) What is said, that they do not use a single Keter until the future, means only in equality with ZA. But with Jacob she is equal in a single Keter for both of them, on Rosh Chodesh and Yom Tov. (Item 58).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 62:1
items.html: (To the question) See above, Answers 6 and 7.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 63:1
items.html: (To the question) See above, Answer 6.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 64:1
items.html: (To the question) Every aspect of the vessels that already served at the time of Nekudim, except that after their shattering they returned and received their correction by the lights of Atzilut, which are called MAH — all these are discerned by the name BAN, whose source is SAG. For the ten Sefirot of Nekudim are the aspects of the points of SAG; but because they became needing to receive correction from MAH, they are discerned as a Nukva toward the MAH, and therefore they are now called BAN, for the Nukva of MAH is called by the name BAN. Hence, in the smallness of the Partzuf, as long as it has no Mochin, there is no correction of the aspects of the lights at all there, but only the completion of the vessels of BAN that are clarified from BYA; and even the Mochin of VAK are only the completion of vessels. It is thus found that there is no aspect of MAH itself there, namely the stature of the Mochin attributed to Atzilut. And the aspect of MAH begins only in the Gadlut, namely in the Ibur, Yenika, and Mochin of face to face, which are the aspect of the GAR of the lights called MAH, which correct the Mochin of BAN, after they clothe in the Ibur, Yenika, and Mochin of the externality of the Partzuf, called BAN, as above. It is thus found that there is no MAH there except in the Gadlut, namely after the VAK and the Mochin of VAK are completed, they become fit to receive the lights of MAH. (Item 64).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 65:1
items.html: (To the question) No inner vessel comes into a Partzuf of VAK except by inclusion from its KHB Partzuf, namely after it also attains the KHB Partzuf, then the VAK Partzuf is also included in it, and then it has an inner vessel in its VAK. But before it attains the KHB Partzuf, there is no inner vessel in the VAK. (Item 70).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 66:1
items.html: (To the question) There is no difference between Netzach and Hod except in the Gadlut, where there is the illumination of Hochma: the Netzach is discerned as the carrier of the illumination of Hochma, and the Hod as the carrier of the screens, and they are aspects separate from one another. But in the smallness, at the time they are in the aspect of VAK, the Netzach is also found to have no difference from the Hod, and it has only the power of the end, like the Hod. (Page 1722, Item 75).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 67:1
items.html: (To the question) The coming of the Hassadim means the coming of the Mochin of the GAR, when the Netzach becomes the aspect of the carrier of the illumination of Hochma in the GAR, in which they are separated from one another, as above, in Answer 196. (Item 75).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 68:1
items.html: (To the question) See above in Answer 67.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 69:1
items.html: (To the question) The part that the lower one has already received from the upper one is discerned as an inner light. And what it is destined to receive from the upper one is discerned, even before it receives it, as illuminating to it in the aspect of a surrounding light, meaning an illumination from afar. (Item 77).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 70:1
items.html: (To the question) Not all the Ibur, Yenika, and Mochin come at once; only the ten Sefirot of Ibur-Yenika come to her at once. And this is because her Ibur is made in the Nukva in the body of ZA, which is considered her root.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 71:1
items.html: (To the question) For the Yesod of the Nukva is not fit to raise MAN for the sake of the GAR of souls, except by that spirit that her husband casts into her in the first union, which ZA gives in the secret of the coupling of back to back, called the 216, and called male Hassadim, because they are drawn from the stature of the AB of the Mazal. See above in Answers 60 and 70, where this is explained at length. And sometimes they are called male Gevurot, namely when only the aspect of the MAN alone is considered. And these she receives at the time ZA is back to back; but at the time of her return face to face with ZA, her Partzuf is corrected not in the aspect of the male MAN of the Mazal, but only in the aspect of feminine Gevurot, which are drawn to her from the Malchut of Ima, which is feminine MAN. See there in Answer 70. (Item 78).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 72:1
items.html: (To the question) The correction of the Nukva of ZA does not begin except after the Gadlut of Neshama, namely after ZA acquires new NHY of Neshama; then there is also an ascent for the Nukva, for the bodies of the Nukva are attached upon the AHAP of ZA, as is known. Then she grows in the GAR, namely in the VAK at once, for her Ibur is made in her inclusion in the Nukva in the body of ZA. (Item 82).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 73:1
items.html: (To the question) After ZA attains the Gadlut of Neshama, the Nukva begins to be built, and her VAK emerge at once, as above in Answer 200. However, the GAR of the Neshama of ZA she cannot attain, because the GAR of the Neshama are taken by the Malchut of ZA himself, namely the Nukva in his body, from the chest and above. That is, those GAR are concealed Hassadim, like the stature of SAG of Aba and Ima; therefore only the great Nukva in the body of ZA takes from them the aspect of Neshama, because her way is in concealed Hassadim. But for the small Nukva they do not suffice for the aspect of the GAR, because she needs revealed Hassadim, and she has from these Mochin of ZA only the aspect of VAK without a head. (Item 82).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 74:1
items.html: (To the question) For the Nukva does not grow throughout the whole back of ZA, but only by the stature of the AB of the Aba and Ima of the Mazal, as is known. And then, just as Aba and Ima and YESHSUT become a single Partzuf, so too the Nukva Rachel, with the great Nukva in the body of ZA, called the Malchut of ZA, they also become a single Partzuf. And it is found that the Nukva has now taken the aspect of the GAR of the Nukva in the body of ZA, for she was made one with her. (Item 83).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 75:1
items.html: (To the question) When the GAR come into the Partzuf, the NH are separated, for the Netzach is then discerned as the carrier of the illumination of Hochma, and the Hod is discerned as the carrier of the screens, as above in Answer 196. And the aspect of the GAR is called the face; it is thus found that the NH are separated in the aspect of the face. Not so from the aspect of the posterior, namely as long as they have no GAR and no aspect of face, the NH are one, for there is no difference of aspect between them, as above, see there. (Part 1, Page 724, s.v. therefore).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 76:1
items.html: (To the question) Like at the time of the Gadlut of Nekudim: after the aspect of the chest and below of ZA, which was in BYA, joined with him into a single Partzuf, then the Nukva also received from them the aspect of the lower nine, and was built into a Partzuf in itself, for the reason that, at the time of the smallness, when the Nukva was the aspect of the point of the chest of ZA, those of the chest and below that were in BYA belonged to the Nukva; therefore she was built from them into a Partzuf, after the Gadlut of ZA. And so it is in Atzilut: after ZA raises his NHY from BYA, there is in those NHY the part of the lower nine of the Nukva, and she too is built into a Partzuf separate from ZA — as in the Gadlut of Nekudim. (Part 1, Page 728, s.v. and behold).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 77:1
items.html: The matter of the division of Aba and Ima and YESHSUT into two Partzufim is because of the stature of SAG in them: for, in permanence, Aba and Ima took the Bina of MAH, namely the ten Sefirot of the stature of SAG, whose upper aspect is Bina, in the light of Neshama. And they nurse from the Bina of AA, which is called the throat. And even though this Bina emerged from the head of AA, nevertheless it is discerned as GAR, because the GAR of Bina are in the secret of for He delights in mercy, and they do not bear any screen; therefore the screen in the mouth of AA does not diminish it from the aspect of head and GAR, as though it had not emerged from the head, as said in the previous parts, that there is no restriction in the light of Hassadim. And all this is said only of the GAR of Bina, which are the KHB HGT in the stature of SAG, whose way is in concealed Hassadim. But in the NHY of Bina, which are the aspects of the roots of ZON in Bina, whose way is in revealed Hassadim — meaning that the illumination of Hochma will be revealed in the Hassadim — the screen in the mouth of AA already rules over them, and they are made lacking a head, namely the aspect of VAK alone. And this is what caused the stature of SAG of Atzilut, which are Aba and Ima, to divide into two Partzufim, into Aba and Ima and YESHSUT: the GAR of the stature are Aba and Ima, whose way is in concealed Hassadim; therefore the stature of Neshama is counted for them as complete GAR, for the screen of the head of AA does not rule over them. And the aspect of the VAK of the stature of SAG, namely the chest and below of Aba and Ima, emerged in the aspect of VAK without a head, for they need revealed Hassadim, and the screen already diminishes them from the aspect of the illumination of Hochma, as long as there is in them only the aspect of SAG, because Bina emerged from the head of AA, as above. And toward revealed Hassadim, there is no aspect of GAR at all in this stature. And this is the root of the division of Aba and Ima and YESHSUT: Aba and Ima alone take the GAR of the stature, and Yeshut and Tevunah are divided from them into a Partzuf of VAK.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 77:2
items.html: (To the question) And accordingly, it is understood by itself that at the time when ZON have only the stature of SAG, which is Neshama, they too are necessarily divided into two Partzufim, like Aba and Ima and YESHSUT: only his KHB HGT up to the chest receive the GAR and the aspect of a head, being the aspect of concealed Hassadim; but the chest and below is separated by itself into a Partzuf of VAK without a head, for the stature of SAG does not suffice to serve them as the aspect of a head, since they need the illumination of Hochma, as above in YESHSUT. It is thus found that when ZA is in the stature of Neshama, he is necessarily divided into two separate Partzufim: from the chest and above is the aspect of the great ZON, in the head of the Neshama; and from the chest and below is the aspect of the small ZON, which emerged by themselves in VAK without a head. (Item 83 and in the Inner Light, s.v. and afterward).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 78:1
items.html: (To the question) Leah is the aspect of the Achoraim of Ima, which were nullified from the heads of Aba and Ima at the time of the diminishment of the moon, and fell to the place of the Nukva of the body, as is known. Therefore she was corrected in Atzilut to be the aspect of the Nukva for ZA, and she receives from his Mochin and is corrected with him. And it is found that Leah is a higher degree than ZA, from her source, and she is truly the aspect of the head of ZA, for Ima is the head of ZA. Therefore, after ZA received the aspect of Neshama, she ascends by him to the aspect of his GAR, namely from the chest and above, and receives from him the GAR equally with the Nukva in the body of ZA, which is from the chest and above. But Rachel, who is the separate Nukva of ZA, is only an offshoot of ZA, and her source is in the Gadlut of Nekudim, after his NHY from BYA joined to him, as above in Answer 206, when a building of the lower nine was made for her from those NHY of the Gadlut. It is thus found that the whole root of Rachel is only in the NHY of ZA, and she has no share from the chest and above of ZA; therefore she was corrected only from the chest and below of ZA, like the Nukva in the body of ZA, which is from his chest and below. (Item 152 and in the Inner Light, s.v. indeed).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 79:1
items.html: (To the question) For then ZA is in the stature of SAG, namely Neshama, and it was explained above in Answer 207 that the stature of SAG does not suffice to illuminate to the chest and below of ZA but the aspect of VAK without a head, since it is there that he needs revealed Hassadim, see there. (Part 1, Page 733, s.v. and behold).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 80:1
items.html: (To the question) This is understood from its source in Nekudim, where the root of the Nukva is at the time of the smallness of ZA, when she is only the aspect of a point below the chest, relative to the vessels, and a point below the Yesod, relative to the clothing of the lights. But at the time of the Gadlut of ZA of Nekudim, when he raised his AHAP from BYA, the Nukva was also built from them, in her upper nine. Therefore the separate Nukva does not exist at all from the beginning, but only after the Gadlut of the Neshama of ZA, when he also raises in Atzilut his new NHY from BYA, from which the Nukva takes her upper nine, as above. And likewise, at the time that ZA himself returns to VAK, and the new NHY are nullified from him, the aspect of the upper nine of the Nukva is concealed with them. (Item 94 and in the Inner Light, s.v. and this).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 81:1
items.html: (To the question) At the time that ZON ascend as MAN to the Hall of the Aba and Ima of AB, when Aba and Ima and YESHSUT become a single Partzuf in an equal stature, both Aba and Ima are discerned as the aspect of Aba alone, and both YESHSUT as the aspect of Ima alone, as is known. And then ZA is included in the aspect of Aba, and the NHY of Aba, which are Aba and Ima, clothe in him, with the Mochin. And the Nukva is included in Ima, which are YESHSUT, and the NHY of YESHSUT clothe in her, with the Mochin. And then ZON are also found, like Aba and Ima and YESHSUT, in an equal stature, and use a single Keter. And then they are in the secret of the two great luminaries. However, this does not operate until the end of correction, for this requires the Nukva to have the aspect of feminine MAN of the first restriction, which is hidden in RADLA and is not revealed until the end of correction, as said above in Answers 6 and 7, see there. (Item 190).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 82:1
items.html: It is known that the whole matter of the new MAH, which is the world of Atzilut, is only to correct the BAN, which are all the statures that emerged in the Gadlut of Nekudim, which were nullified and shattered; and by the couplings of the new MAH in Atzilut, they receive their correction, all the statures returning to enter as they were before the nullification and the shattering. And it is known that they are divided into two divisions: for first the heads of the upper Aba and Ima emerged, whose from-above-downward are the four kings of the HGT up to the chest; and because of the shattering of these four kings, the Achoraim of the upper Aba and Ima were also nullified, which are all the aspect of their AHAP that rose to them at the time of the emergence of their statures, from below upward; after the nullification of the statures, these Achoraim returned and fell to the place of their bodies, namely to the place where the kings of the HGT stood. And afterward, the four statures of the YESHSUT of Nekudim emerged, from below upward, whose from-above-downward are the four kings of NHY M. And after their shattering — the four kings of NHY M — the Achoraim of YESHSUT were also nullified, which are the AHAP that joined to them at the time of the emergence of these statures, from below upward; and after their nullification, the AHAP of every stature returned and fell to the place of its body, as is known.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 82:2
items.html: And it is found that the end of correction cannot be before these Achoraim that fell from Aba and Ima and YESHSUT return to their place, as at first, before their nullification; and then all the vessels of the eight kings will also be corrected with them, and they will return to be Atzilut in their place, as at first. For every stature that is corrected in Aba and Ima and YESHSUT raises from BYA also the vessels belonging to the from-above-downward of that stature, as is known. And the order of the raising of these Achoraim is discerned in five aspects.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 82:3
items.html: The first aspect is in the Mochin of the weekday, which are the aspect of YESHSUT, coming by the bowing of the head of the Yechida-Chaya down to the place of the Neshama. Then ZA raises, with his MAN, only the aspect of the Achoraim that fell from the YESHSUT of Nekudim to the place of the HGT of AA, where ZA stands at the time of his Ibur; that stature raises the vessels and sparks of the four kings of NHY M of Nekudim that are in BYA. However, this raising is not a complete raising even for the Achoraim of YESHSUT, because the place of the raising of the Achoraim must be in the place of the GAR of AA, whose place is aligned opposite the place of the emergence of the Yeshut and Tevunah of Nekudim. For the GAR of AA clothe the HGT of Atik, which stand in the place of the four kings of the HGT, in whose place the head of the YESHSUT of Nekudim emerged. And since the raising of the Achoraim was only to the place of the HGT of AA, and the coupling was made by the bowing of the head of Aba and Ima, from the place of the GAR of AA to the place of his HGT, as is known — therefore the Achoraim of YESHSUT have still not risen in this to their true place, as at first.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 82:4
items.html: The second aspect is in the Mochin of Shabbat at Musaf, when ZON ascend as MAN to the place of the GAR of AA, and raise there the Achoraim of YESHSUT, which then stand in the GAR of AA. And here a complete raising is made of the Achoraim of YESHSUT, for now YESHSUT stand in their place, in their standing at the time of Nekudim, for the GAR of AA are aligned opposite the YESHSUT of Nekudim, as above.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 82:5
items.html: The third aspect is the Achoraim of Aba and Ima, which ZON also raise in that same ascent of the Ibur, to the place of the GAR of AA, namely on Shabbat at Musaf, as above. For, with regard to the Achoraim of Aba and Ima, it is similar to the first aspect with regard to the Achoraim of YESHSUT, mentioned above: they have still not risen to their true place, which is the place of the GAR of Atik, for the GAR of Atik stand aligned in the place of the GAR of Nekudim, where is the standing of the Aba and Ima of Nekudim, as is known. Rather, they are still in the place of their fall, which is the place of the HGT of Nekudim, namely the place of the GAR of AA, as above, except that they receive correction by the bowing of the head of Aba and Ima, who are now in the place of the GAR of Nekudim.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 82:6
items.html: The fourth aspect is at Shabbat Mincha, when ZA ascends as MAN in an Ibur to YESHSUT, who stand in the place of the GAR of Atik; and it is found that he now raises the Achoraim of Aba and Ima to their true place, to the place of the GAR of Nekudim. And there is now a complete raising also for the Achoraim of Aba and Ima. However, there is still a lack in the aspect of the stature, for here at Shabbat Mincha there is only the stature of the SAG of the Yechida of ZA; therefore the Nukva can no longer ascend with him as MAN, to the place of the GAR of Atik, and he is divided, because of this, into two Partzufim, of which only ZA and Leah can receive these Mochin and clothe the GAR of AA; but Jacob and Rachel remained below, in the place of the HGT of AA, as is known. Therefore, all the Achoraim of Aba and Ima have still not risen in completeness.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 82:7
items.html: (To the question) The fifth aspect is at the end of correction, when the Nukva will also be fit to raise MAN to the GAR of Atik, for then the Malchut hidden in RADLA will be revealed, in the secret of the cornerstone. And then all the aspects of the Achoraim of Aba and Ima will rise in completeness, to their place, as at first; and then there will be the end of correction. And in order to understand this answer well, one must well remember all that is explained in Answer 9, see there.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 83:1
items.html: (To the question) As in the adjacent answer: the raising of the Achoraim of Aba and Ima comes to their place only at the time that the coupling and the Ibur are made in the place of the GAR of Atik, see there.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 84:1
items.html: (To the question) The VAK are called externality, and the GAR are called internality. And YESHSUT are the aspect of the VAK of Aba and Ima; therefore they are called externality, relative to Aba and Ima, who are called internality.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 85:1
items.html: It was explained above in Answer 7 that only ZA and Ima can use the male MAN of the Dikna, being from the aspect of the upper nine of the direct light, in which, from the measure of the first restriction, there is no femininity in the upper nine, but only in Malchut alone. Therefore the aspect of femininity in them is only the aspect of inclusion from Malchut, called Benjamin included in Joseph, like the MAN of the Dikna. But the Nukva Rachel, who is the aspect of Malchut itself, cannot receive these male MAN of the Dikna, but she needs the Malchut of the first restriction, which is hidden in RADLA, until the future. Therefore Rachel cannot ascend with ZA as MAN to the GAR of Atik, for her MAN of the first restriction, which she needs, is not revealed there.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 85:2
items.html: (To the question) And therefore only ZA and Leah, who are the aspect of the upper nine of the direct light, can be included in the Ibur of YESHSUT that is in the place of the GAR of Atik, and clothe the GAR of AA, for they have there the aspect of the MAN of the first restriction that suffices for them, namely from the aspect of the Yesod of Malchut that is in the Dikna. Therefore they ascend at Shabbat Mincha and clothe the place of the GAR of AA. But Rachel cannot ascend with them, for she has no aspect of her own MAN there, which is the Malchut of the first restriction, for it is hidden in RADLA and does not come into a coupling until the future. And see well in Answer 7.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 86:1
items.html: (To the question) Every degree needs anew Ibur, Yenika, and Mochin, both in the externality and in the internality, as is known. Therefore, although ZON were already completed in the degree of Chaya, at the Musaf of Shabbat, nevertheless, from the aspect of Yechida, they have still received nothing until Shabbat Mincha. And these Mochin of Mincha are only the aspect of the Neshama of the Yechida, which suffice only for the great ZON and Leah; but for the small ZON they do not suffice for the aspect of the GAR, but only for the aspect of VAK alone. Therefore they remained below, in the HGT of AA, and did not ascend with them to the GAR. And it is found that these Jacob and Rachel, who stand in the HGT of AA at the time of the ascent of ZON to the GAR of AA, are the Jacob and Rachel of the aspect of Yechida. And see above, Answer 215, where we explained another reason for why Rachel does not ascend to the GAR of AA; and both are true.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 87:1
items.html: (To the question) See above in Answer 216.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 88:1
items.html: (To the question) The matter is said of the Atzilut of the smallness of the Nukva, namely of the aspect of the ten Sefirot of VAK. And it is known that before the Partzuf is completed in the aspect of the smallness, it cannot ascend by itself as MAN, for it has no existence in itself yet, as above in Page 738, Item 6. Therefore only ZA ascends as MAN by himself, which suffices for the building of the smallness of the Nukva. But afterward, when she has already been built in the aspect of her VAK, from the chest and below, she too can ascend as MAN to Aba and Ima, as said there in the words of the above-mentioned Rav: that in the second time, after the Partzuf already has the measure of the VAK, it can ascend by itself as MAN to its upper one, see there. (Item 99).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 89:1
items.html: (To the question) For the external ones have a hold only in a place where there is a lack in the lights. Therefore, since the Mochin of SAG do not suffice for the GAR for the small ZON, the external ones have a hold in their Achoraim, and they must be attached back to back, in the secret of their backs to the house. But from the chest of ZA and above, where he has the GAR, the external ones have no hold, and the Achoraim can be revealed. (Item 102).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 90:1
items.html: (To the question) The matter of ZON being back to back indicates that their ascent to Aba and Ima is to receive the Mochin of the Achoraim. However, the coupling itself that they make in Aba and Ima is necessarily face to face, for they are included there in Aba and Ima, and Aba and Ima are face to face. But in general, these couplings and Mochin are called back to back, because they come only for the completion of the vessels, and the aspect of the vessels is called BAN, and also Achoraim and externality. (Item 103).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 91:1
items.html: (To the question) See below in Answer 222.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 92:1
items.html: Sleep and slumber mean: the ascent to MAN. For at the time that the Mochin ascend as MAN, and the Partzuf remains below without Mochin, it is discerned as sleeping, like a sleeping man whose brains are not revealed at that time. And for this very reason, the birth of the Mochin and their return to clothe in the Partzuf is called his awakening from his sleep. Therefore, at the time of the ascent of the MAN of ZON to Aba and Ima, for the sake of the Mochin of the separation, ZA is discerned as sleeping, for his brains departed and ascended as MAN to Aba and Ima. But Leah is discerned as awake, for she receives there immediately these Mochin of the separation, namely the Binot and Gevurot of Aba and Ima, which are included in Ima; and Leah, who is included in Ima at the time of the ascent of the MAN, receives them immediately, and descends with them below, to her place, and is sawed apart from ZA — that is, by receiving these Mochin of AB, she becomes a Partzuf separate in itself. For beforehand, in the Mochin of SAG, she had only the aspect of the concealed Hassadim of the GAR of Ima, like the Mochin of ZA himself; and since she was equal to him in the kind of Mochin, she was discerned as though attached to him. But now that Leah received the aspect of the Mochin of revealed Hassadim, from the AB of Ima, by the ascent of the MAN, she is separated from the aspect of the Mochin of ZA. For the Mochin of ZA are always in the aspect of concealed Hassadim, and even at the time of his attainment of the Mochin of AB; except that he is then made in the aspect of the final MEM of Tzelem, which bestows the illumination of Hochma to the LAMED of Tzelem, even though he himself is only the aspect of concealed Hassadim, as is well explained in Part 13, see there. However, Leah, after she received the Binot and Gevurot of Aba and Ima, was made into revealed Hassadim, like the LAMED of Tzelem; therefore she is now found to have been sawed apart from ZA. And this matter has already been explained above, in the Mochin of face to face of midnight, that Leah receives from ZA, when Leah then receives the vessels of Rachel as a loan; this is necessary for her, because she receives the Mochin in the long NHY of Ima, meaning the Mochin of AB, which are long, for long means Hochma. See there.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 92:2
items.html: And behold, the reason why the Nukva Leah is discerned as awake is because she descends immediately with the Mochin of the separation that she received, and is sawed apart from ZA; and since she has Mochin, she is discerned as awake, as above. But ZA himself does not descend below until he also receives there the Mochin belonging to Rachel, for Rachel cannot receive the Mochin immediately, in the Hall of Aba and Ima, like Leah, because she is an offshoot of ZA, and Aba and Ima are considered the higher upper ones of Rachel, as is known. Therefore Rachel does not receive the Mochin except after ZA awakes from his sleep, namely after ZA descends below, to his place, and bestows them to her; and this descent of ZA is made by the shofar blast, on Rosh Hashanah; then Rachel receives the Mochin of the separation from ZA, in the manner of the degree. Therefore Leah is discerned as awake, and not sleeping, for she received immediately the Mochin fit for her. But ZA, who needs to bestow the Mochin to the Nukva Rachel, does not descend from there except after the shofar blast; and then he awakes and bestows the Mochin to Rachel. Thus, what is said, that at the time of the dormita the female is not asleep, revolves only on the Nukva Leah, since she receives the Mochin immediately and descends below. But in Rachel this does not operate, as above, for she descends equally with ZA, at the time of the shofar blast, as explained (in Item 122).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 92:3
items.html: (To the question) And what the Rav wrote above in Item 163: When Bina and Gevura departed from ZA, then they illuminated in the Nukva Leah in the secret of a surrounding light, and from there it is drawn to the Malchut Rachel, and they are not asleep like ZA — from which it is implied that Rachel also is not asleep — the intention is on the aspect of the vessels of Rachel that join to Leah, from midnight until morning; from this aspect one can say that Rachel also receives the Mochin immediately, at the time of the ascent of the MAN, namely by the lending of her vessels to Leah (as above, Part 14, Item 35). However, this receiving is not discerned by the name of the building of the Partzuf of Rachel, for Rachel needs to receive the Mochin by means of ZA, namely after his awakening from his sleep, in the secret of the shofar blast, and not by means of Leah, as the Rav wrote above in Item 163. Rather, it revolves on the vessels of Rachel that join to the Partzuf of Leah, at the time that Leah receives the long NHY of Ima; at that time Rachel is found receiving the Mochin by means of Leah, as explained. And what is said, that they illuminate in Leah in the secret of a surrounding light, is because the Mochin of BAN, from their own attribution, are discerned as a surrounding light, as above in Item 179, that they are not discerned as an inner light except from the aspect of their connection with the MAH, because their root is from the lights of Nekudim, which are the aspect of an upper one relative to Atzilut, as said there. And since this receiving is only of Binot and Gevurot alone, therefore they are called a surrounding light. (Items 204, 163, and 122).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 93:1
items.html: (To the question) See above in Answer 60. (Item 105).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 94:1
items.html: (To the question) For at the time of her smallness she has only the bodies, lacking the AHAP, namely the KHB HGT of the vessels, lacking the NHY. And this is in general and in particular: in every Sefira there is nothing but the upper two thirds, and it is lacking the lower third. And in this state she has no Yesod and Malchut at all, for these are only the includers of the HGT NH, and are not actual Sefirot like them; rather, the Yesod is the includer of the five Hassadim, and Malchut is the includer of the five Gevurot, as is known. Therefore, as long as the HGT NH themselves are lacking the lower third, it is impossible to correct from them the including aspect for the Yesod, and the including aspect for the Malchut. Therefore they are entirely lacking at the time of the smallness of the Nukva. Hence the Nukva has no existence of her Yesod except after she attains the Mochin of AB from the Ima of the Mazal, which lower the Hey from the eyes and raise the AHAP; then the NHY of the generality are completed, and in particular all the lower thirds of her ten Sefirot are then completed to her; and then the existence of the Yesod emerges in her: for after the HGT NH are completed in the lower thirds, then their including aspect makes the vessel of the Yesod, as above. It is thus found that the vessel of the Yesod is made only after the Nukva has received the Mochin of the GAR, which are the Mochin of the separation. (Item 108).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 96:1
