items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 97:1
items.html: (To the question) The Gevurot of the Nukva are not her own, for from herself she is rooted only in the Malchut of Ima, which is the second restriction, and no Mochin emerge upon her except by the inclusion of the Malchut of Ima in the crown of Gevura of ZA, as is known. Therefore she is the aspect of a soft Din, for all the Gevurot of the first restriction that are in her are only the aspect of an illumination that she receives from the Gevurot of ZA, as above. But ZA does not need to receive the illumination of Gevurot from another, for he receives the aspect of the Gevurot of the first restriction from his source, from the Mazal VeNotzer, which is the aspect of the Yesod of Malchut, from the first restriction, as is known. Therefore his NHY, which is the place of the end, are harsh Dinim, for the aspect of the first restriction is the measure of the harsh Din, in which the world cannot exist except with its partnership with the measure of mercy, as is known. Therefore, the further it goes, the Dinim grow in it, and his NHY have no sweetening except in their clothing in the Mochin of the Nukva, who is the aspect of the Malchut of Ima and the second restriction; and there they are sweetened in the measure of the mercy of Ima. (Item 112).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 98:1
items.html: (To the question) One, is the sawing of the Dinim from the chest of ZA and above, up to his Keter, where is the aspect of the Nukva in the body of ZA, which is the aspect of the male Gevurot of the first restriction, like the Ima of the AB that is upon the MAN of the Dikna, being the aspect of ZA himself, who can receive these male MAN, as above in Answer 6, see there. And the second is the chest and below of ZA, namely the Dinim that belong only to the small Nukva Rachel, who is the aspect of a soft Din from her source, namely from the Malchut of Ima, which is the measure of mercy, as above in Answer 227. Therefore, even though she now receives from the aspect of the Gevurot of the male MAN, like ZA, nevertheless they are sweetened in her by means of ZA, because she is a soft Din from her source. (Item 115).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 99:1
items.html: (To the question) At the time of the slumber, meaning the ascent of the MAN of ZON to Aba and Ima, who are in the place of AB, there Aba is entirely MAH, namely his Hochma and Hassadim, and those of Ima. And Ima is entirely BAN, namely her Binot and Gevurot, and those of Aba. And it is found that ZA, who is included there in Aba, is also entirely MAH, namely the Hochma and Hassadim of Aba and Ima, as well as the right half of the upper and lower Daat, which also belongs to MAH. And the Nukva, who is included there in Ima, is entirely BAN, like Ima, namely the Binot and Gevurot of Aba and Ima, as well as the left side of the upper and lower Daat, which are also counted as BAN. And the Binot and Gevurot that the Nukva takes are counted immediately, as they clothe in her, namely in the aspect of Leah, who borrows the vessels of Rachel, as above in Answer 222, see there. But ZA, who does not descend from there except at the time of the shofar blast, as said there — it is found that the Mochin of Hochma and Hassadim and half the upper Daat and the lower Daat, which he takes there from Aba, are for him only in the aspect of Makifim; for as long as ZA is in Aba, the Mochin are discerned only as Makifim for the aspect of his VAK, which remained in slumber below, as said below in Answer 254, see there. (Items 160 and 161).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 100:1
items.html: (To the question) That is the male Gevurot that she receives from Ima, by the power of the inclusion of the Hod of AA in his Netzach; then she does not need to receive the illumination from the crown of Gevura of ZA, as at the time she is face to face, but she receives the male Gevurot themselves, from Ima, as said in Answers 6 and 7, see there. (Item 118).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 101:1
items.html: (To the question) The whole matter of the attachment of back to back in a single wall with ZA, which operates in the Nukva at the time she is with him, from the chest and below, is because she lacks the aspect of her NHY; therefore there is no coupling in her, in her own aspect, but she receives through the small Nukva in the body of ZA. Hence she is attached to him in his body, like the small Nukva in his body. However, at the time that she receives the Mochin of Binot and Gevurot, from the Ima of the AB of the Mazal, which lower the Hey from her eyes and raise the AHAP, which are new NHY, when she attains the vessel of the Yesod, she is separated from him into the aspect of a particular Partzuf, for now she has her own Achoraim and wall; and also in the aspect of revealed Hassadim, as is known. It is thus found that the giving of the Gevurot not through ZA, namely the Mochin of Binot and Gevurot that she receives from Ima, which build her Achoraim, is what causes her to be sawed apart from ZA, to be a separate Partzuf in itself. And see above in Answer 230. (Item 119).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 102:1
items.html: (To the question) For at the time that ZA has Mochin of SAG, Leah is then corrected like the great Nukva in the body of ZA; therefore her Mochin are found equal to the Nukva of ZA in his body, namely the aspect of the concealed Hassadim of the GAR of Bina. Hence Leah is then counted as though she is attached to him, for her Mochin are equal to his. However, at the time that she receives the Mochin of the AB of the Ima of the Mazal, which are the Mochin of the separation, then Leah joins with Rachel, who is from the chest and below, and is made into a single Partzuf; and her Mochin are found in the aspect of revealed Hassadim, which are different from ZA. Therefore she is now discerned as having been sawed apart from ZA. And see above, Answer 222. (Items 120 and 125).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 103:1
items.html: (To the question) Because after her receiving the Mochin of the separation from ZA, she has in those Mochin two sweetenings: one from Ima herself, namely from the time she was in the Hall of Aba and Ima, in the aspect of MAN; and the second, by means of ZA, who gives them to her a second time, in the manner of the degree. (Item 124).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 104:1
items.html: (To the question) Because the Gevurot that are from the chest and above are of the degree of ZA himself, and they are fit to be received from Aba and Ima themselves, who are considered their upper one; therefore she receives them immediately, with her ascent as MAN, and they are sawed apart. But from the chest and below are the Gevurot belonging to Rachel, who is considered the third degree from Aba and Ima, and she is obligated to receive the Gevurot a second time, by means of ZA in his place, who is her upper one. Therefore, from the Keter of ZA to his chest, they are sawed apart in all their completeness, on the first day of Rosh Hashanah; but the Gevurot from the chest and below begin to be sawed apart on the first day, after the shofar blast, by her receiving then from ZA; and so they go and are sawed apart during the Ten Days of Repentance, until they are completed on Yom Kippur. (Item 124).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 105:1
items.html: (To the question) The Mochin are given to Leah first, because she can receive directly from Aba and Ima, like ZA, and she receives them immediately. Therefore the Gevurot from the chest and above, which are counted as of the degree of ZA himself, are sawed apart immediately, with their ascent as MAN, and are given to Leah, as above in Answer 222, see there. But after the shofar blast, when ZA descends to his place and gives the Mochin to Rachel, for the building of her Partzuf, then the Mochin emerge from Leah and are given to Rachel; and then Rachel necessarily receives the Gevurot from the Keter to the chest, which is the aspect of the Nukva in the body of ZA that Leah had taken beforehand; and now this belongs to Rachel, for she ascends and clothes ZA in an equal stature, up to the Keter. But before ZA descended to his place, Leah received the Mochin and also the Gevurot from the Keter to the chest, namely before the shofar blast, as above. (Part 1, Page 756, s.v. and there is no).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 106:1
items.html: (To the question) For at the time that they are in the Hall of Aba and Ima, namely before the shofar blast, when ZA is included there in Aba, and the Nukva in Ima, it is discerned that the Nukva takes there the Gevurot by means of Ima herself, not through ZA, for she is included in Ima and takes the Mochin from her, just as ZA is included in Aba and takes the Mochin from him. However, this reception from Ima does not suffice for the Nukva, because she is her higher upper one; therefore she needs to return and receive them by means of ZA himself, and this comes to her after the shofar blast, during the Ten Days of Repentance. And it is found that only on the first day, before the shofar blast, the Nukva receives by means of Ima; but after the shofar blast of the first day, ZA has already come to his place, and she takes them by means of ZA alone. However, remember that also these Mochin that she takes by means of ZA, during the Ten Days of Repentance, are also called from Ima, not through ZA: for although she takes them by means of ZA, nevertheless the Mochin themselves are attributed to Ima, because they come from the AB of the Ima of the Mazal, which are male MAN. And only the Mochin of face to face are discerned as taken by means of ZA, to indicate that they come from the coupling made in the head of ZA, and not from the coupling of the Aba and Ima of the Mazal. (Item 128).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 107:1
items.html: (To the question) Although he says that the Mochin of the separation, which grow her throughout the whole back of ZA, she takes by means of ZA himself, during the Ten Days of Repentance, nevertheless the Mochin themselves are attributed to Ima, not through ZA, being drawn from the coupling in Aba and Ima upon the MAN of the Mazalot, as above in Answer 136. And what he is precise to say of the Mochin after the shofar blast, that they come by means of ZA and not through Ima, is only to distinguish the place of reception: for before the shofar blast, when ZON are still in the Hall of Aba and Ima, the Nukva is found included in Ima, and she takes them from the hand of Ima herself. And after the shofar blast, when ZON have already descended to their place, she takes them from the hand of ZA. But these Mochin, in general, are discerned as coming from Ima, and she receives them in the NHY of Ima. And only the Mochin of face to face come from ZA, and she receives them in the NHY of ZA. (Items 125 and 134).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 108:1
items.html: (To the question) For on the first day, the Dinim are sawed apart from the chest and above, up to his Keter, which are, from their source, the aspect of male Gevurot; and so they are even in the Mochin of face to face. And since they are male Gevurot — meaning the aspect of the Yesod of the Malchut of the first restriction, drawn from the Mazal VeNotzer — it is discerned that the separation made on the first day of Rosh Hashanah is a harsh Din, for they are of the measure of judgment, namely the first restriction. But on the second day, where there are no Dinim but those of Rachel, who is, from her source, the aspect of the Malchut of Ima, and her measure of judgment is hidden in RADLA — therefore the sawing of those Dinim is discerned by the name of a soft Din. And see above in Answer 228 (Items 129, 130, and 131).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 109:1
items.html: Before the separation there is in ZA MAH and BAN, for in the smallness there is in him VAK of MAH and VAK of BAN; and in the Gadlut there is in him, from the chest and above, the GAR of MAH and BAN, and from the chest and below there is in him VAK of MAH and BAN. And ZA himself is discerned as MAH, and the aspect of his left side, namely the Nukva in his own body, which is the Malchut of his nine Sefirot, is called BAN, as is known. But after the separation, the whole side of BAN in him is sawed apart from him, namely the aspect of the Nukva in his body, and is given to the Nukva Rachel; then ZA remains entirely Hesed, which is MAH, and the Nukva is entirely Din, which is BAN.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 109:2
items.html: (To the question) And although, even after the separation, there is in him the aspect of the crown of Gevura, which is Din — and moreover, it is the aspect of a harsh Din, namely from the aspect of the first restriction, called the root of Din — nevertheless it does not serve in him for his own need, but in order to illuminate the Mochin in the Nukva Rachel. And this resembles the aspect of Aba and Ima and YESHSUT: even in the Mochin of AB, which is Hochma, Aba and Ima are discerned as the final MEM of Tzelem and concealed Hassadim, and the aspect of the Hochma they bestow to YESHSUT, who are the LAMED of Tzelem, and the aspect of revealed Hassadim. And yet Aba and Ima are called Hochma, even though they are concealed Hassadim, because they are the root of Hochma, except that they do not need the Hochma for their own need, but to bestow to YESHSUT, who need it. And in this manner here, in ZON: truly, the root of the Gevura and of the Mochin is only in ZA; nevertheless, he is discerned in the aspect of the final MEM of Tzelem, which is entirely concealed Hassadim, in the secret of the pure ring; therefore he does not use the Mochin for his own need, but to bestow to the Nukva, for only she needs the illumination of Hochma, being the aspect of revealed Hassadim. (Item 132).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 110:1
items.html: (To the question) In the permanent Mochin of Atzilut, when Aba and Ima are in the stature of SAG, the VAK of the Hochma and Bina of BAN were divided between Aba and Ima: Aba took the VAK of the Hochma of BAN, and Ima took the VAK of the Bina of BAN. However, at the time of the ascent of Aba and Ima to the GAR of AA, and their attainment there of the stature of AB, by the bowing of the head of the GAR of Atik to the place of the GAR of AA, Ima attains there the GAR of the Hochma and Bina of BAN that Atik took; therefore also the VAK of the Hochma of BAN of Aba join to her, and she is entirely BAN, and Aba himself is entirely MAH. For the MAH of Ima joined to Aba, and the VAK of the Hochma of BAN of Aba joined to Ima. Thus, only in the stature of SAG of Aba and Ima does each of them have MAH and BAN. But from the stature of AB and above, Aba is found entirely MAH — the MAH of MAH and the MAH of BAN — and Ima is entirely BAN — the BAN of MAH and the BAN of BAN. (Item 140).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 111:1
items.html: (To the question) The Mochin of ZA at the time of their emergence in the AVI of AB — Aba was entirely MA and Ima entirely BON, as above in Answer 240. However, at the time of the birth of the Mochin, AVI returned to their fixed state, and the BON was again divided between AVI, so that MA and BON are found in Aba alone, and likewise MA and BON in Ima alone. Hence, the NHY of Aba, together with the Mochin that must clothe in ZA, now contain MA and BON — so how will they clothe in ZA, which is entirely MA alone? And likewise, how will the NHY of Ima, together with the Mochin, clothe in the Nukva, which is entirely BON, when the NHY of Ima also contain MA? Therefore, the Mochin in these NHY of AVI must now be exchanged, so that the NHY of Aba will also receive the MA that is in the NHY of Ima, and the NHY of Aba will be entirely MA, as at the time of the emergence of the Mochin in the GAR of AA; and likewise the NHY of Ima will receive the BON that is in the NHY of Aba, and Ima will be entirely BON, as at the time of the emergence of the Mochin. Then the NHY of Aba will be able to clothe in ZA, which is entirely MA, and the NHY of Ima will be able to clothe in the Nukva, which is entirely BON. (Item 140).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 112:1
items.html: (To the question) Because the Mochin come from the AVI of AB, in which Aba is entirely MA and Ima entirely BON, as above in Answer 241. Hence, ZA, which is included in Aba, has Mochin that are all MA, like Aba. And the Nukva, which is included in Ima, has Mochin that are all BON, like Ima. (Item 142).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 113:1
items.html: (To the question) See Answer 7. (Item 142).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 114:1
items.html: (To the question) The Nukva, from her root, is nothing but the point of the ending of ZA, namely the point of the chest, from the aspect of the vessels. And she is the aspect of the Keter of the Nukva, for in the vessels it is always discerned that the upper ones grow first. And she is a point under the Yesod, from the aspect of the lights that clothe in the vessels, and from this aspect she is the Malchut of the Nukva, namely the tenth phase. For in the lights it is always discerned that the lower ones enter first. Therefore, before the Nesira she has nothing but the aspect of her root alone, which is the tenth phase, as above. And after the Nesira she takes all the aspects of the Nukva that are in the body of ZA, which are the Malchuts of his ten Sefirot, from Keter to the Malchut within him, and then she is built into a complete Partzuf of her own. (Item 144).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 115:1
items.html: (To the question) For the root of the Nukva, which is a point under the Yesod of ZA, is from the aspect of the vessels of the inner face of Nekudim, namely of the seventh king, from the aspect of what came out at the time of the smallness of Nekudim. And it is known that everything that comes into Atzilut from the vessels of the inner face of Nekudim is never subjected to any diminution whatsoever, because their breaking was not due to themselves, but only due to their intermingling with the vessels of the back; and therefore, once they were sorted, they are no longer diminished. (Item 145).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 116:1
items.html: (To the question) The return of the Nukva to a point does not nullify anything of the building of her back Partzuf, for this return means the ascent of MAN, since in every ascent of MAN all the aspects of the additions in the Partzuf must ascend, and nothing remains below but the aspect of the permanence alone, which in ZA is the aspect of VAK and in the Nukva is the aspect of a point. Thus, the matter of her return to a point is only what remains in her below, in her place, at the time that her nine [Sefirot] ascended above, in the secret of MAN, in order to receive the Mochin of the face. (Item 146).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 117:1
items.html: The nine Sefirot of every stature are alluded to in the names of HaVaYaH and their fillings. The nine Sefirot of the stature of AB: its Keter is alluded to in the simple HaVaYaH alone, for every Keter is the root of the stature, and the simple HaVaYaH is the root of all the fillings that come in it. And the Sefira of Hochma of AB is the ten letters of the HaVaYaH in the filling of Yudin, as follows: Yud, Hey, Vav, Hey. And the Sefira of Bina of AB is the HaVaYaH of Yudin in the filling of the filling, as follows: Yud Vav Dalet, Hey Yud, Vav Yud Vav, Hey Yud — which are 28 letters. And the Sefira of ZA of AB, namely its HGT NHY, is the ten letters of the HaVaYaH in the filling of Yudin, like the Sefira of Hochma of AB, for in this ZA is equal to Hochma, in the secret of "his name is MA and the name of his son is MA, as you know." And thus the nine Sefirot of the face of the stature of AB are explained, and this is only the aspect of the first nine [Sefirot] of every Sefira, which are the male of this stature. But the Malchuts of every Sefira, which are the left side of the stature, namely the aspect of the Nukva within his body, are the aspect of the number and Gematria of the four kinds of HaVaYaH mentioned above.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 117:2
items.html: (To the question) For the Malchut of Keter is the number of the four letters of the simple HaVaYaH, which is 26. And the Malchut of Hochma is the number of the HaVaYaH in the filling of Yudin, which is 72. And the Malchut of Bina is the number of the 28 letters of the HaVaYaH of Yudin in the filling of the filling, which are 610. And the Malchut of ZA is 72, namely the number of the HaVaYaH in the filling of Yudin. And thus the Malchuts of the nine Sefirot of the face of the stature of AB are explained. (Item 147).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 118:1
items.html: (To the question) The square of the letters of HaVaYaH and their fillings allude to the aspect of the Sefirot of the backs of that stature. For example, in the HaVaYaH of the stature of AB, whose nine Sefirot of the face were explained above in Answer 247: the back of the Keter of AB is the ten letters of the square of the four letters of the simple [name], as follows: Yud, Yud Hey, Yud Hey Vav, Yud Hey Vav Hey. And the back of the Hochma of AB is the square of the ten letters of the HaVaYaH in the filling of Yudin, as follows: Yud, Yud Hey, Yud Hey Vav, Yud Hey Vav Hey — which are 26 letters. And the back of the Sefira of Bina of AB is the 156 letters of the square of the 28 letters of the filling of the filling, as follows: Yud, Yud Vav, Yud Vav Dalet, Yud Vav Dalet Hey, Yud Vav Dalet Hey Yud, Yud Vav Dalet Hey Yud Vav, Yud Vav Dalet Hey Yud Vav Yud, Yud Vav Dalet Hey Yud Vav Yud Vav, Yud Vav Dalet Hey Yud Vav Yud Vav Hey, Yud Vav Dalet Hey Yud Vav Yud Vav Hey Yud. And the back of the ZA of AB is equal to the back of the Hochma of AB, namely the 26 letters of the square of the HaVaYaH in the filling of Yudin, as above. And the backs of the Malchuts of these nine Sefirot of the backs of AB are the number of each one, for the back of the Malchut of the Keter of AB is the Gematria of the ten letters of the square of the simple HaVaYaH, whose Gematria is 72. And the back of the Malchut of the Hochma of AB is the number of the 26 letters of the square of the HaVaYaH in the filling of Yudin. And the back of the Malchut of the Bina of AB is the number of the 156 letters of the square of the 28 letters of the filling of the filling. And the back of the Malchut of ZA is similar to the back of the Malchut of the Hochma of AB. And in this manner, as the nine Sefirot of the faces and the backs and their Malchuts in the stature of AB were explained, so it is in the HaVaYaH of SAG and the HaVaYaH of MA and the HaVaYaH of BON: Keter is the simple HaVaYaH in them, Hochma is the HaVaYaH in the filling, Bina is the filling of the filling, and ZA always resembles the Hochma of that stature. And likewise the nine Sefirot of the backs of every stature are always the aspect of the squares, in the manner explained in the stature of AB. And the aspect of the Malchuts of the nine Sefirot of the faces is the Gematria of the Havayot and their fillings in the straight [order]. And the aspect of the Malchuts of the nine Sefirot of the backs is the Gematria of the Havayot and their fillings in the square.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 119:1
items.html: (To the question) See above, Answers 247 and 248.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 120:1
items.html: When ZA is only in the aspect of the Mochin of the back, he has only the squares of the four kinds of HaVaYaH mentioned above in Answer 248, namely: the ten letters of the square of the simple HaVaYaH in his Keter; the 26 letters of the square of the ten letters of the HaVaYaH in the filling of Alephin in his Hochma; the 156 letters of the square of the 28 letters of the filling of the filling of the HaVaYaH of Alephin in his Bina; and the 26 letters of the square of the ten letters of the HaVaYaH in the filling of Alephin in his ZA.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 120:2
items.html: (To the question) And the Nukva of ZA is then the aspect of the Gematria of the four kinds of HaVaYaH in the square mentioned above, as above in Answer 248, which is called the Nukva within his body, namely his left side. And it is found that the Gematria of 72 of the back of the Malchut of the Keter is attached to the ten letters of the square of the simple HaVaYaH. And likewise the Gematria of the 26 letters of the square of the HaVaYaH of Alephin, which are the Malchut of Hochma, is attached to the 26 letters of the square themselves, which are the Sefira of Hochma. And likewise the Gematria of the 156 letters of the square of the filling of the filling, which is the back of the Malchut of Bina, is attached to the 156 letters themselves, which are the Sefira of Bina. And likewise the Gematria of the 26 letters of the square of the HaVaYaH in the filling of Alephin, which is the back of the Malchut of ZA, is attached to the 26 letters themselves, which are the back of the Sefira of ZA of ZA. And afterwards, at the time of the Nesira, these nine Malchuts mentioned above are sawn off from the nine Sefirot of ZA and given to the Nukva Rachel.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 121:1
items.html: (To the question) They are the four kinds of HaVaYaH mentioned above in Answer 248, in the aspect of the straight [order] within them. For the four letters of the HaVaYaH in the straight are the Keter of the face of ZA; and the ten letters of the HaVaYaH in the filling of Alephin are the Hochma of the face of ZA; and the 28 letters of the filling of the filling of the HaVaYaH of Alephin are the Bina of the face of ZA; and the ten letters of the HaVaYaH in the filling of Alephin are the HGT NHY of the face of ZA. And the aspect of the Gematrias of these four kinds of HaVaYaH are the nine Malchuts of the face of ZA.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 122:1
items.html: (To the question) The separate Nukva is the HaVaYaH in the filling of Heys, whose Gematria is 52, as follows: Yud, Hey, Vav, Hey. And the four kinds of HaVaYaH act within her alone, in her nine Sefirot: the nine Sefirot of the face are in the straight, and the Malchuts of the face are their Gematria; and the nine Sefirot of the back are the four kinds of squares, as above; and their Gematria is the Malchuts of the back.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 123:1
items.html: (To the question) They are the aspect of the Malchuts of ZA himself, called the Nukva within the body of ZA. (p. 767, Sub Header “Achorim”).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 124:1
items.html: (To the question) The Hochma and Hesed of ZA are called surrounding [lights] at the time of the slumber, namely at the time of the ascent of MAN to AVI, because they ascended there to the palace of AVI as MAN; for since ZA remains below with only VAK, and his Mochin are found in AVI, they are discerned there above as the aspect of surrounding lights (Or Makif) for his VAK. (Item 151).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 125:1
items.html: (To the question) At the time that ZA has only the Mochin of SAG, as the stature of the permanent AVI, he too is found divided into two Partzufim, like AVI and YESHSUT: the great ZON, which are from the chest and above, are like AVI, in the aspect of covered Hassadim; and the small ZON, which are from the chest and below, are in revealed Hassadim, like YESHSUT. And this is the matter of the division of the Nukva of ZA into two halves: Leah is like the aspect of the great Nukva within his body, which is from the chest and above; and Rachel is like the small Nukva within his body, which is from the chest and below. (Item 152).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 126:1
items.html: (To the question) Leah is the aspect of the backs that fell from the Ima of Nekudim to the place of the Nukva of ZA, and therefore in Atzilut she is corrected through the Mochin of ZA. However, since she is from the aspect of Ima herself, she always receives from the aspect of the GAR of ZA, for Ima is the GAR of ZA, and even the Malchut of Ima is also the aspect of GAR in relation to ZA, as is known. Therefore, at the time that ZA receives the Mochin of Neshama, that correction also reaches Leah, but in the aspect of his Nukva, namely in resemblance to the great Nukva of ZA, which is from the chest and above. Hence, she always clothes in the place of the great Nukva of ZA. (Item 152).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 127:1
items.html: (To the question) See above, Answer 208. (Item 152).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 128:1
items.html: (To the question) At the time that Leah and Rachel are made into one Partzuf, when Leah is nullified to her measure, which is the aspect of covered Hassadim, and received the measure of Rachel, which is revealed Hassadim — nevertheless, the measure of Leah was not nullified then entirely, but it is discerned that Leah clothed in the internality of Rachel, and Rachel clothes over her from the outside. Hence, the aspect of Rachel rules then, for everything external is what is revealed and what rules. (Item 152).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 129:1
items.html: (To the question) This means at the time that they are made into one Partzuf. For then Rachel ascends and clothes Leah, and takes her place in the coupling for revealed Hassadim, and the measure of Rachel is completed in the internality of Leah, as above in Answer 258. And it is found that the upper half of Rachel is Leah, for she is clothed in her internality. (Item 152).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 130:1
items.html: (To the question) At the time that ZON return face to face, Rachel takes all the aspect of the Nukva within the body of ZA, as above, Item 50. And it is known that the NHY of Aba that clothe in ZA are entirely MA: MA of MA and MA of BON. And the NHY of Ima that clothe in the Nukva within the body of ZA are entirely BON: BON of MA and BON of BON. Therefore, now that the separate Nukva, Rachel, took the aspect of the Nukva within the body of ZA, she too is the aspect of BON of BON and BON of MA. And this is what [the Rav] says: at the time that ZON are face to face, ZA is found with the face and back of MA of MA and the face and back of MA of BON, and the Nukva with the face and back of BON of MA and the face and back of BON of BON. And the matter of “face and back” means that even the Mochin of the back, from before their coming to face to face, also remained in them, and therefore they have face and back, as above in Answer 246. (Item 154).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 131:1
items.html: (To the question) The aspect of Nefesh-Ruach of the Ruach of ZA is discerned as the aspect of his body, and it is the aspect of the six vessels of the face that were corrected from the aspect of the ZAT of the smallness of Nekudim, as is known. Hence, these VAK are fixed in him forever, and no diminution will ever occur in them. However, the Mochin of VAK, which are the GAR of Ruach, and all the more so the Mochin of GAR, are not fixed in him, being the aspect of additions drawn from the vessels of the back of Nekudim. Thus, everything that ZA has beyond Nefesh-Ruach of the Ruach is called by the name of Mochin, and they are what ascend as MAN, being the aspect of additions that depart. (Item 155).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 132:1
items.html: (To the question) In the first coming (Bi'a), he gives her that spirit (Ruha) that her husband casts into her, called “216, back to back”, and it is the aspect of BON of BON, namely the BON of the aspect of the Ima of the Mazalot, where there is nothing of the aspect of MA of BON, for the MA of BON is there the aspect of Aba. And this first coming, although it is from the aspect of back to back, is nevertheless very important, being from the aspect of the male Gevurot, by which she becomes fit for the ascent of the MAN of souls. And afterwards, in the second coming, namely in the coupling face to face, he gives her the MA of BON, namely the aspect of the Hassadim and Hochma of Ima; and this is not for the building of her Partzuf, but for the need of the souls. (Item 156).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 133:1
items.html: (To the question) The soul of a male comes only from MA, but there are souls that come from the Gevurot, namely from the MA of BON, for the entire BON is Gevurot. (Item 158).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 134:1
items.html: (To the question) The souls of males are drawn only from MA, either from MA of MA or from MA of BON. And the females are drawn only from BON, either from BON of MA or from BON of BON. And it is always related to the aspect of its male: if the male is from the aspect of MA of MA, the Nukva will be BON of MA; and if the male is from MA of BON, the Nukva will be from BON of BON. (Item 158).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 135:1
items.html: (To the question) The soul of Hevel was shared from MA of MA and MA of BON, and therefore his Nukva was also from BON of MA and from BON of BON. And it was over this BON of BON that Cain was jealous, for the soul of Cain was from MA of BON, and it is found that the BON of BON of the Nukva of Hevel belongs to Cain. (Item 157).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 136:1
items.html: (To the question) All the statures that came out in Atzilut are called the general MA, for all of Atzilut is drawn from the new MA. And the lights and vessels that already served in Nekudim, and after their nullification and breaking came and were corrected in Atzilut, are called the general BON. And the aspect of BON is made into the aspect of left and Nukva for the aspect of MA, as is known. Hence, the right shoulder of AA is from the general MA, and the left shoulder of AA is from the general BON. (Item 158).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 140:1
items.html: (To the question) Through the Mochin of the Nesira, which are from the AVI of AB, which is Hochma, Leah and Rachel are made into one Partzuf, namely that Leah takes the measure of Rachel and receives Mochin of the illumination of Hochma, as the aspect of Rachel; hence she becomes like her, and it is discerned that Rachel ascended and clothed Leah, and Leah became her internality. And through the inclusion of Leah and Rachel into one, Rachel grows up to the Keter of ZA, in his back. (Item 175).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 141:1
items.html: (To the question) Daat is not a new Sefira, but the Tifferet of the smallness becomes Daat at the time of the greatness, for the HGT of the smallness become the KHB of the greatness, as is known. (Item 177).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 142:1
items.html: (To the question) The inner Partzuf of AVI is the stature of AB. And the stature of AB is in AVI only through their ascent to the GAR of AA, and the Mazalot of AA become for them Daat, as above in Part 13. Hence, the stature of AB of AVI is called by the name “Mazal of the name AB”. (Item 178).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 143:1
items.html: (To the question) The lights of BON are called by the name of surrounding lights (Or Makif) because at the time that they receive their correction through the new MA, their lights that served within them in Nekudim are awakened in them; and since Nekudim is the aspect of the upper in relation to the MA of Atzilut, they are therefore discerned as surrounding lights, for the lights that are in the upper are surrounding lights for the lower. However, certainly they clothe in them in the aspect of inner light (Or Pnimi), except that the Rav hints by this that the whole aspect of their revelation is from the aspect that precedes Atzilut, and therefore he calls them by the name of surrounding light. (Item 179).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 144:1
items.html: (To the question) Hesed means the Mochin of AB, when a wall is made for ZA from Hassadim and a wall for the Nukva from Gevurot, and then they separate from one another into two distinct Partzufim. See above, Answer 67, where this is explained at length. (Item 181).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 147:1
items.html: (To the question) All the aspects of addition in ZA, which are from the GAR of Ruach and above, ascend to AVI in the secret of MAN. And only the aspect of Nefesh-Ruach of the Ruach, which is in him permanently, remains below in the secret of the slumber. (Item 84).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 148:1
items.html: (To the question) This is the rule: everything that is in the lower one, he takes from the aspect corresponding to him in his upper one. Therefore, the Mochin of the externality, which are the Mochin of VAK, namely the internality of the externality, he takes from the NHY of the internality of the externality of Ima, namely from the aspect of the NHY of this Partzuf, for ZA. And the Mochin of the three aspects of the Aba and Ima of the internality, he receives from the three Partzufim of the Aba and Ima of the inner Ima, which clothe in the NHY of that Partzuf and afterwards clothe in the three Partzufim of the Aba and Ima of ZA. And this is what he says: “First the GAR of the externality of ZA return into the internality of the externality, namely the NHY of Ima; and afterwards the three aspects of the internality of ZA return within the three aspects of the internality of the NHY of Ima.” For this is the rule, that in the lights the lower ones are found coming first, and therefore first the Mochin of VAK return into the NHY of the internality of the externality of Ima; and afterwards come the Aba and Ima of the aspect of the GAR, called the Aba and Ima of face to face, which come in the three aspects of the Aba and Ima of the internality of Ima, clothed in the NHY of each one, as above. (Item 185).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 149:1
items.html: (To the question) It is known that the four kings of HGT are the aspect of the upper-lower of the upper AVI of Nekudim, and the four kings of TNHYM are the aspect of the upper-lower of the YESHSUT of Nekudim. And the backs of AVI, which were nullified at the time of the breaking of the vessels, fell to the place of HGT; and the backs of YESHSUT fell to the place of TNHYM, as said in Part 7, see there. And it is known that the essence of ZA is from the chest and above, but from the chest and below is the aspect of the Nukva. Hence, ZA raises the backs of AVI, because they fell to his place, to the place of HGT, which were his heads. But the backs of YESHSUT belong to the Nukva, for they fell to the place of the four kings of TNHYM, which are the aspect of the Nukva, as above. (Item 189, and in Pnimi, Sub Header “At the death”).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 151:1
items.html: It is known that through the ascent of the bottom Hey to the eyes, which was made in Nekudim, every degree was divided into two: for from the Nikvey Eynayim and below of every degree, namely its AHP, fell from it and became the lower degree. Thus the AHP of the Keter of Nekudim fell to the degree of AVI, and the AHP of AVI fell to the degree of ZAT, as said in Part 7. And through the MAN of the Vav and the point that AVI received from the Yesod of the inner AK, which are the aspect of ZON, there came out there the aspect of the mutual gaze of the eyes of AVI, which are the Mochin of the stature of Keter in AVI, and they raised their AHP from the ZAT of Nekudim and joined them to their degree, in the heads of AVI. And from there the seven kings came out one after another, as said there.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 151:2
items.html: And you find that through the MAN of ZON that AVI received from the Yesod of AK, two aspects were made: one, that they caused a coupling between AVI in the aspect of face to face; and two, that they caused the raising of the vessels of the AHP to AVI. And it is known that although ZON were born and went out to their place, nevertheless they left there, in AVI, the aspect of their MAN, in the secret of standing and existence. And at the time of the breaking of the vessels of ZON, the MAN of standing and existence was nullified from AVI, and they fell together with the vessels of the AHP that had been raised to them through these MAN; and these two aspects are called the backs of AVI. And they depend on one another, for the vessels of the AHP did not ascend to AVI except by the force of the ascent of the MAN of ZON.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 151:3
items.html: (To the question) Therefore, also in the world of Atzilut, when ZON return and raise the MAN to AVI, it is found that according to the measure of the stature that comes out upon these MAN that ZA raised to them, according to that same measure the vessels of their AHP that fell to the ZAT also return and ascend, and are joined to the heads of AVI, as it was in Nekudim. Thus, with the raising of the MAN of ZON, the backs of AVI are also found ascending. (Item 189).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 152:1
items.html: (To the question) From the Mochin of VAK of ZA and above, they already cause ascents to all the Partzufim of AK and ABYA. But the VAK themselves of ZA, which are the aspect of Nefesh-Ruach of the Ruach, are according to the fixed Mochin in Atzilut, which never change: where Atik is Keter, AA is Hochma, AVI and YESHSUT are Bina, and ZA is VAK — namely, according to the statures of the new MA. (Item 188).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 153:1
items.html: (To the question) The first way is that Aba and YESHSUT are made one, and Ima and Tevuna are made one, as above (page 946, Item 150). The second way is that the upper AVI are both made into the Partzuf of Aba, and YESHSUT are made into the Partzuf of Ima, and they both couple in an equal stature, as said (in Etz Chaim, Gate 19, end of Chapter 8). The third way is that Tevuna ascends above, to the place of the upper Ima, and the coupling of Aba is made with Tevuna and not with the upper Ima (as said in Etz Chaim, Gate 14, Chapter 8, and in Gate 4, Chapter 3). And one must always ponder, regarding the joining of AVI and YESHSUT, all these three ways mentioned above. And they also apply to the joining of Leah and Rachel into one Partzuf (as said below, in Answer 284, p. 792, Sub Header “And from the beginning”).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 154:1
items.html: (To the question) The three ways that apply to the joining of AVI and YESHSUT into one Partzuf, as above in Answer 283, which indicate three distinct discernments that were made due to the joining — they also apply to the joining of the great ZON with the small ZON into one Partzuf, and in them too there are those same three indications. In the first way it is discerned that ZA and Yaakov are made one Partzuf, and Leah and Rachel are made one. And this indicates that the male is entirely MA: MA of MA and MA of BON. And the female is entirely BON: BON of MA and BON of BON. And the second way is that the great ZON are both made into ZA alone, and the small ZON grow to an equal stature with ZA, and they are both made into the aspect of Nukva alone — namely, like the second way of AVI. And this indicates that ZA remains, after the Nesira, entirely Hesed, namely in the aspect of covered Hassadim, like the upper AVI, who are the aspect of the closed Mem of Tzelem and covered Hassadim, as above in Part 13. And the Nukva becomes entirely revealed Hassadim, like the aspect of the small ZON, which resemble YESHSUT. And the third way is that Rachel grows and ascends above and takes the place of Leah, and Leah becomes her internality. And this indicates that the coupling is made in the aspect of Rachel, who needs the illumination of Hochma, like Tevuna — and not in the aspect of Leah, who does not need the illumination of Hochma, like Bina, which does not need the illumination of Hochma, as is known. Therefore Leah is hidden and becomes the internality of Rachel. And this resembles the third way of AVI mentioned above. (p. 792, Sub Header “And likewise”).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 155:1
items.html: (To the question) For the Mochin of ZA come out only upon the MAN of the Mazal, which are the aspect of the MAN of the first restriction; and these MAN are indeed male MAN, namely the Yesod of the Malchut of the first restriction, which suffice only for the great ZON, which are above the aspect of Malchut. But the Nukva Rachel needs the aspect of female MAN, namely from the aspect of the Malchut of the first restriction; therefore she cannot receive the Mochin from the NHY of Ima, namely from the NHY of YESHSUT, as above in Answer 285, in the second way — because she has no share in the MAN of Ima, which come from the MAN of the Mazal, being male Gevurot from the Yesod of Malchut. Therefore she has no Mochin of face to face with which to couple with ZA, except through the illumination of the crown of Gevura (Atara de-Gevura) of ZA in the Malchut of Ima, as is known. Hence, throughout the six thousand years she needs to receive the Mochin from ZA, in the clothing of his NHY, and not in the clothing of the NHY of YESHSUT. However, at the end of correction, the Malchut of the first restriction will be revealed in RADLA, in the secret of “head of the corner” (Rosh Pina), and then Rachel will have the aspect of female MAN of the first restriction, and will be able to be included in Ima and receive the Mochin from her by herself. Then the NHY of YESHSUT will clothe in the Nukva, like the NHY of AVI in ZA, and they will both use one crown. See Answer 7. (Item 189. And Or Pnimi, Sub Header “However”).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 158:1
items.html: It is known that the five Partzufim of Atzilut, according to the statures of MA within them, are the VAK of the five Partzufim of AK, and their entire correction is to ascend and clothe the five Partzufim of AK. And one must understand the reason for this — why the correction of the five Partzufim of Atzilut depends on the matter of clothing the five Partzufim of AK, up to its Galgalta.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 158:2
items.html: And the matter is that in truth, the matter of correction is said only with regard to what was corrupted in the breaking of the vessels of Nekudim. But there, in Nekudim, at the time of the emergence of the greatness of Nekudim, before they were broken, the three heads of Nekudim were clothing the three Partzufim — Galgalta, AB, and SAG of AK. And one must remember here the order of the emanation of the GESMB of AK, which came out one below the other due to the refinement of the screen of phase four in the Partzuf of the Galgalta of AK: from the force of its refinement to phase three, the Partzuf of AB of AK came out; and afterwards, when it was refined to phase two, the Partzuf of SAG of AK came out; and after it was refined to phase one, the Partzuf of Nekudim came out in the stature of YESHSUT, which is phase two of clothing and phase one of thickness (Aviut), being YESHSUT that came out from the eyes of SAG of AK, called the world of Nekudim, as is known. However, in Nekudim there is an additional matter beyond the aspect of the refinement of the screen to phase one: from the force of the joining of the NHY of SAG in the NHY of AK, the two Heys joined together — the bottom Hey, which is phase four, ascended and became mixed with the upper Hey, which is phase two, and both together joined in the screen of the Nikvey Eynayim, which is phase two of clothing and phase one of thickness, as above.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 158:3
items.html: And at first the smallness (Katnut) of Nekudim came out, from the aspect of the Nikvey Eynayim, in the stature of YESHSUT, and there came out there three heads, one below the other: the first head is YESHSUT, from the Tabur and above, swallowed in the Akudim, and is not counted in the account of the Partzuf of Nekudim. And afterwards came out two heads, male and female, called Keter and AVI of Nekudim: the male, which is in the stature of YESHSUT of clothing, is the second head, called Keter; and the female, which is in the stature of ZA, namely in phase one of thickness, is the third head, called AVI; and after them came out the ZAT.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 158:4
items.html: And after the GAR received the illumination of AB and SAG, which brought the screen down from the eyes to the Peh, and the thickness of phase four, which had previously been mixed in phase two, was revealed again — namely that the bottom Hey descended from the upper Hey and came to its place, in the Peh, since the AHP ascended to their place — and after the Yesod of AK bestowed the Vav and the point upon this Peh, then the ten Sefirot came out there, upon the phase four in that Peh, in the stature of Keter, as said there at length. And this stature of Keter is equal to the Galgalta of AK, for this stature too came out upon phase four, like the Galgalta of AK; and it is found that all three heads of Nekudim were joined into one stature, like the Galgalta of AK, and they clothed the Galgalta of AK, as above.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 158:5
items.html: However, there is no absence in the spiritual, and since the three heads of Nekudim came out at first one beneath the other, therefore also in their greatness, when they attained the stature of the Galgalta of AK, they must also divide and receive the Mochin one from the other, in the manner in which they came out one from the other at the time of the smallness. Hence it is discerned that only the first head clothed the Galgalta of AK, but the second head, which is the Keter of Nekudim, also came out now from the Peh of the first head, and therefore clothes the HGT of the first head, which are the HGT of the Galgalta, being the stature of AB of AK, for the AB of AK clothes the HGT of the Galgalta. And likewise the third head was born and came out from the Peh of the second head, and clothes its HGT, which are the HGT of the AB of AK, and it is the stature of SAG of AK, for the SAG of AK clothes the HGT of AB, as is known. Thus, the first head clothed the Galgalta of AK, the second head the AB of AK, and the third head the SAG of AK.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 158:6
items.html: And know that from the aspect of the greatness of Nekudim, in which the bottom Hey returned and descended from the eyes, and all the Parsot (firmaments) that were made by the second restriction were nullified, and the first restriction returned to its place as at first, the Partzuf of Nekudim is found to have returned to be the aspect of AK itself. For all the distinction between AK and ABYA is only in that the Partzufim of AK are from the first restriction, while ABYA are from the second restriction, as is known. And it is found that now, in the greatness of Nekudim, after the aspect of the second restriction was nullified from them, they returned to be the aspect of AK; and their five Partzufim clothed the five Partzufim of AK, GESMB. For the three heads of Nekudim became the GAS of AK, as above; and it is found that AVI clothed the SAG of AK. However, YESHSUT were then included in AVI, for all the division of AVI and YESHSUT was because AVI are discerned as the aspect of the Taamim of SAG, which were not mixed with the bottom Hey, while YESHSUT are discerned there as the Nekudot of SAG, which were mixed with the bottom Hey, by force of their clothing in the MA and BON of AK, as the Rav said above, page 396, item 6, see there. And it is found that now, in the greatness of Nekudim, after all the aspect of the mixture of the bottom Hey was nullified entirely, there is no longer any difference between the Taamim of SAG and the Nekudot of SAG, and AVI and YESHSUT are found to have become one Partzuf.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 158:7
items.html: And nevertheless, since the greatness of Nekudim did not endure, for it returned and was nullified, a certain distinction still remains between AVI and YESHSUT; and therefore one must still discern that YESHSUT is slightly distinct from AVI and remained below the Tabur of AK, for only AVI, which have no connection whatsoever with the bottom Hey, since their root is from the Taamim of SAG, therefore ascended above the Tabur and clothed the SAG of AK; but not so YESHSUT, which remained from the Tabur and below, in the place of the GAR of Nekudim. And in truth, both of the above discernments apply there.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 158:8
items.html: And it is found that YESHSUT clothe the GAR of Nekudim, and therefore they are discerned as the MA of AK; and the ZAT of Nekudim are the BON of AK, as the Rav said above: that YESHSUT are the crowns (Tagin) and MA, and the ZAT are the letters and BON. And thus the five Partzufim of AK are explained according to the measures of the statures of the ten Sefirot of the greatness of Nekudim: the first head of Nekudim clothes the Galgalta of AK; the second head, which is the shoulder (Katef), clothed the AB of AK; the third head, which is AVI, clothed the SAG of AK; and the head that separated from AVI, which is YESHSUT, clothed the GAR of Nekudim, which are the MA of AK; and the ZAT of Nekudim clothed the BON of AK.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 158:9
items.html: However, all the greatness mentioned above did not endure, for because of the breaking of the vessels, the MAN of the Vav and the point in the Peh of Nekudim, upon which all this greatness came out, were nullified, and all the statures mentioned above departed; and their backs, namely the AHP that had been raised to each stature, returned and fell, each head to its own lower, as said in Part 7. And it is now well understood that the whole matter of the correction is not finished unless all the statures mentioned above return to clothe the five Partzufim of AK, as they clothed at the time of the greatness of Nekudim, before they were nullified and broken. And understand this well, for without this there is no understanding of the matter of the end of correction that is on the tongue of the Rav.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 158:10
items.html: And with this you will understand that the five Partzufim of Atzilut, as they were corrected from the aspect of the fixed Mochin within them, are the VAK of the five Partzufim of AK, each one toward the aspect corresponding to it in AK. For the three heads of Atzilut, which are Atik, AA, and AVI, correspond to the three heads of Nekudim: the first head, which clothes from the Tabur and above of AK, corresponding to Atik of Atzilut; the second head, which is the Keter of Nekudim, corresponding to AA of Atzilut; and the third head, which is the AVI of Nekudim, corresponding to the AVI of Atzilut. Therefore, the correction of Atik is not finished until it clothes the Partzuf of the Galgalta of AK, and the correction of AA is not finished except in its clothing the Partzuf of AB of AK, and the correction of AVI is not finished except in their clothing the SAG of AK — for these three Partzufim resemble the three heads of Nekudim that clothed the GAS of AK. And the YESHSUT of Nekudim must clothe the MA of AK, which is in the place from the Tabur and below of AK, where the GAR of Nekudim stood at the time of the smallness, for the reason explained above — that they are the aspect of the Nekudot of SAG, see there. And the ZON of Atzilut must clothe the BON of AK, in the place of the ZAT of Nekudim, which is there the aspect of the BON of AK, as above.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 158:11
items.html: And until they reach this, there are here three ascents, which are NHY, HGT, KHB, where each Partzuf of Atzilut ascends upon the Partzuf corresponding to it in the five Partzufim of AK. The ascent of NHY is in the Mochin of Hol (weekdays), which come from YESHSUT. And you must remember that the GAR and the ZAT of Atik clothe exactly the GAR and the ZAT of Nekudim. And the GAR and the ZAT of AA clothe exactly the ZAT of Nekudim, namely the stature of the BON of AK mentioned above, to which the stature of the ZON of Atzilut must reach. Hence, according to this, the NHY of AA are the aspect of the NHY of the ZAT of Nekudim in their entirety, and the HGT of AA are the HGT of Nekudim, and the GAR of AA are the head of the ZAT of Nekudim. Thus, if you divide the ZAT of Nekudim into RTS (Rosh, Toch, Sof), which are KHB, HGT, NHY, they are equal to the RTS of AA.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 158:12
items.html: And it is found that in the Mochin of Hol, when ZA ascends and clothes the YESHSUT of Nekudim, which are from the chest and below of AA, the five Partzufim of Atzilut are found, each having ascended and clothed the NHY of the five Partzufim of AK, each one in the aspect corresponding to it. For ZA, which ascended and clothed from the chest and below of AA, is found to have attained, in completeness, the measure of the NHY of the RTS of the ZAT of Nekudim, to which the NHY of AA correspond. And likewise YESHSUT ascend then and clothe the place of the AVI of Atzilut, which are the aspect of the NHY of the GAR of Nekudim, for AVI clothe the HGT of AA, which clothe the NHY of Atik from the chest and below, and the Peh of AA stands in the place of the chest of Atik. And you already know that the stature of Atik is in the GAR of Nekudim; and since YESHSUT clothe from the chest and below of Atik, they attained the NHY of the general stature of Nekudim, which is the aspect corresponding to them in the MA of AK, as above.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 158:13
items.html: And likewise AVI ascended then and clothed the GAR of AA, whose stature is in the ZAT of Nekudim, which are the aspect of the NHY of SAG of AK, for the GAR of Nekudim are considered the HGT of SAG of AK, and the ZAT are their NHY. Thus, AVI attained now the aspect of the NHY of the SAG of AK, which is the aspect corresponding to them. And likewise AA ascended and clothed the GAR of Atik, which stands in the place of the GAR of Nekudim, being the aspect of the NHY of the Galgalta and the NHY of the AB of AK, for although the AB ends above the Tabur of AK, nevertheless the NHY of the AB are included in the NHY of the Galgalta, which clothe in the GAR of Nekudim. And likewise Atik ascended and clothed the SAG of AK, which stands in the place of the chest of the Partzuf of the Galgalta of AK; and it is found that it ascended from the place of the Tabur of AK to the place of the chest and below of AK, by which it completed the clothing of the aspect of the NHY of the Partzuf corresponding to it in AK.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 158:14
items.html: And in the Mochin of the Musaf (additional prayer) of Shabbat, all the five Partzufim of Atzilut ascended a second ascent, and each clothed the HGT of the aspect corresponding to it in AK. For ZA ascends then and clothes the AVI of Atzilut, which clothe the HGT of AA, standing in the place of the HGT of the RTS of the ZAT of Nekudim, as above; and ZA attained the HGT of the BON of AK, which is the aspect corresponding to it. And likewise YESHSUT ascended then and clothed the GAR of AA, which stand in the place of the HGT of Nekudim; thus they too attained the HGT from the aspect corresponding to them, which is the GAR of Nekudim, being the MA of AK. And likewise AVI ascended then and clothed the GAR of Atik, which stands in the place of the GAR of Nekudim, considered the HGT of SAG, as above; and it is found that they attained the HGT from the aspect corresponding to them, which is the SAG of AK. And likewise AA ascended then and clothed the SAG of AK, which clothes the HGT of the AB of AK; thus AA attained the HGT from the aspect corresponding to it, which is the AB of AK. And likewise Atik ascended then and clothed the AB of AK, which clothes the HGT of the Galgalta of AK; thus it too attained the HGT from the aspect corresponding to it, which is the Galgalta of AK.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 158:15
items.html: And the third ascent is in Mincha of Shabbat, when all the five Partzufim of Atzilut ascend, each to the aspect corresponding to it, and clothe the KHB in the five Partzufim of AK. For ZA ascends then and clothes the GAR of AA, which stands in the place of the KHB of the ZAT of Nekudim, as above; and it is found that ZA attained the degree of the KHB of the BON of AK. And likewise YESHSUT ascended then to the GAR of Atik, which stands in the place of the GAR of Nekudim, where is the stature of the KHB of the aspect corresponding to them, which is the MA of AK, as above. And likewise AVI ascend then to the SAG of AK, where is their KHB of the aspect corresponding to them in AK. And likewise AA ascends to the AB of AK, where is its KHB of the aspect corresponding to it in AK. And likewise Atik ascends to the Galgalta, where is its KHB in AK. Thus, it is explained how, through the three ascents, each of the five Partzufim GESMB of Atzilut ascends and clothes the GESMB of AK.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 158:16
items.html: (To the question) However, this is still not the end of the correction, for YESHSUT must ascend and join with AVI in the SAG of AK, which is impossible at this time, but only in the future, after the second restriction is nullified entirely, and the light of the Parsot is nullified and BYA return to become Atzilut. Then the Nekudot will join into one with the Taamim of SAG, for there will no longer be anything to distinguish between them, as above; and then YESHSUT will also ascend from the GAR of Nekudim, and will join with AVI and clothe the SAG of AK. And then will be the end of correction. (p. 797, Sub Header “And with this”, throughout the continuation).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 159:1
items.html: (To the question) Yaakov and Rachel do not come out from the Nukva except at the time that she has Mochin that come out in the place of the AVI of the AB of the Mazal, when the backs of AVI are also corrected through these Mochin — namely Yaakov and Rachel: Yaakov is corrected from the Mochin of Aba, and Rachel from the Mochin of Ima. And it is known that in the return of the Nukva face to face with ZA, she no longer has these Mochin of AVI, but she receives the Mochin from ZA, out of the coupling made at the head of ZA upon the Malchut of Ima. Then the backs of AVI, which are Yaakov and Rachel, cannot receive any correction from her, for they are corrected only in the Mochin that come out in AVI, as explained. (Item 190. And p. 803, Sub Header “And this”. And Item 208. And in Pnimi there, Sub Header “Yaakov”).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 160:1
items.html: (To the question) It is known that ZA has his root in the four kings of HGT of Nekudim, which came out from the Mochin of the AVI of Nekudim. And the Nukva has her root in the four kings of TNHYM of Nekudim, which came out from the Mochin of the YESHSUT of Nekudim. Therefore, ZA of Nekudim has no aspect of complete Mochin except at the time that he ascends for the Ibur to YESHSUT, which are in the place of the GAR of Atik, and is born to the place of the GAR of AA — which is on Shabbat at Mincha, for then his Ibur is found in the place of the AVI of Nekudim, since the GAR of Atik are in the place of the AVI of Nekudim. And when he is born from there, he is found clothing the GAR of AA, which are in the place of the four kings of HGT of Nekudim; and then the Mochin of ZA are as they should be. But not so on Shabbat at Musaf, when the Ibur is in the place of the GAR of AA, where is the place of the YESHSUT of Nekudim; and when he is born, he comes to the HGT of AA, which are in the place of the TNHYM of Nekudim, where these Mochin are for him only the aspect of the VAK of the Mochin, for YESHSUT are the VAK in relation to AVI, and he needs the Mochin that come out in the AVI of Nekudim. Hence it is discerned then that from the aspect of the Mochin attributed to ZA himself, he has then only inner VAK. And see above, Answer 10. (Item 193, p. 806, Pnimi, Sub Header “And this”).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 161:1
items.html: (To the question) The aspect of the second Ibur of the externality is the aspect of nine months, because in the first Ibur of the externality, the Ibur of ZA was in the place of the HGT of AA, and he was included only in the VAK of AA; but now, in the second Ibur of the externality, when he is included at the time of his Ibur in the GAR of AA, three months from the GAR of AA are added here, and there are nine months. But in the third Ibur of the internality, there is no novelty in the aspect of the GAR of Atik in which he is included at the time of his Ibur, because also in the second Ibur, at the time he was included in the GAR of AA, he was also included in the GAR of Atik, since by the force of the bowing of the head, the two heads of Atik and AA are considered as one. And all the novelty here is in his inclusion in the ZAT of Atik itself, for since the Ibur was made in the place of the GAR of Atik, it is found that when he is born, he clothes the ZAT of Atik, being the aspect of the upper-lower from the Peh of Atik. Hence it is called the Ibur of seven months, after the ZAT of Atik. (Item 194).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 162:1
items.html: (To the question) It was explained above in Answer 290 that from the Mochin of Shabbat at Musaf, ZA still has only the aspect of inner VAK, because the ascent of the MAN of ZA and the coupling was made in the place of the GAR of AA, where is the place of the head of the YESHSUT of Nekudim, and only the backs of that YESHSUT ascended; but from the backs of the AVI of Nekudim, nothing has yet ascended, until the Mincha of Shabbat, when the Ibur is made in the place of the GAR of Atik, see there. And it is found that, nevertheless, a correction also reached the aspect of the backs of AVI, in their place of fall, through the exit of this head of YESHSUT and Tevuna, as said in Part 7; and likewise a correction reached the kings of HGT through it, see there. However, this correction that reached the kings of HGT through the exit of the head of YESHSUT is only the aspect of VAK and externality, for YESHSUT are the VAK of AVI. And from this aspect, here too, in the Musaf of Shabbat, a correction of VAK and externality, called the aspect of worlds, reached ZA through the completion of the backs of the YESHSUT of Nekudim. And this is what he says — that these Mochin are for the birth of worlds, meaning VAK and externality. However, from the aspect of the four kings of TNHYM, whose entire correction is completed to perfection through this head of YESHSUT, ZA can give birth to the aspect of souls. Thus, what he says — that the Mochin are for the birth of souls — are the Mochin of the souls of the four kings of TNHYM of Nekudim. And what he says — that they are for the birth of the aspect of worlds — is from the aspect of the four kings of HGT of Nekudim. (Item 193. And Item 197. p. 806, Sub Header “And this”).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 163:1
items.html: (To the question) It cannot be imagined that the NHY of Ima should be without the NHY of Aba, as the Rav said, page 950, Item 156, see there. And what he said — that only the NHY of Ima clothe in the Nukva — means the NHY of Ima from the Mochin of the Mazal of AB, when Ima is entirely BON, namely BON of Aba and BON of Ima. And the aspect of the BON of Aba is discerned as coming in the NHY of Aba. (Item 207).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 164:1
items.html: (To the question) They were made one from the aspect of the Mochin of Chaya, from AVI. But from the Mochin of Yechida they have not yet been made one, for then, at Mincha, he has only the aspect of the Mochin of Neshama of Yechida. (p. 811, Sub Header “And there is no”).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 165:1
items.html: (To the question) For the illumination of Mordechai is the Yesod of Aba, which shines at the time that the NHY of Aba clothe in the Nukva. And it is known that in the Mochin of face to face, the Mochin of the Nukva do not come from AVI, nor are they clothed in their NHY, but they come from the Mochin of ZA and are clothed in the NHY of ZA; therefore the illumination of Mordechai is not there, as above. (Item 217).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 166:1
items.html: (To the question) This is done through the ascent of the NHY of AA to the HGT of AA, and the HGT of AA to its GAR, and its GAR to the GAR of Atik. And it is found then that ZON, which were in the NHY, now ascended with the NHY of AA to its HGT, to the place of the two shoulders. And AVI, which stand in the HGT, ascended now, with the HGT of AA, to its GAR. And then the coupling of the GAR of AA was made in the place of the GAR of Atik, upon the MAN of the Dikna, for the Dikna was then made into the aspect of internality and MAN, as above in Part 13. And through the bowing of the head, this coupling was also made in the place of AVI, which are now in the GAR of the fixed AA, and AVI also couple upon the MAN of the Mazalot, in the secret of the coupling of the palate and the throat (Chekh ve-Garon). And likewise, through the bowing of the head of AVI to the place of their fixed GAR, which is in the place of the HGT of AA, where YESHSUT and ZON, which ascended there, now stand, that same coupling is also made in the YESHSUT and the HGT of AA; and then ZON are also included and receive in this coupling. And the Nukva receives the drop of the AB of the Mazal, which brings down the bottom Hey from her eyes and raises the AHP; and the lower thirds of her ten Sefirot are completed, and she separates from ZA. And by this she attained a complete Partzuf, fit afterward to receive the Mochin of face to face through ZA. And this is discerned as a building by AVI, for the Nukva, from her own side, is not fit to receive the aforementioned Mochin through the bowing of the head of the AVI of the AB of the Mazal, because the MAN of the Mazal are the aspect of male MAN, which only Ima can be included in, being the aspect of the first nine, since from the aspect of the first restriction all the first nine are all male, and there is no female in them at all. Hence Ima can receive the male MAN of the Dikna; but Malchut, which is the aspect of female also from the first restriction, is not at all fit to be included in these MAN, but needs the MAN of Malchut; and the Malchut of the first restriction is not revealed until the future, as is known. Rather, by the force of the inclusion of the Hod of AA in its Netzach, the Nukva was made like the Malchut of ZA, and by this she is fit to ascend with ZA to the HGT of AA and to receive the Mochin of the AVI of the AB of the Mazal, through their bowing of the head to their place, as above. Therefore she is discerned as having her entire building of her Partzuf not in the way of degree, but through the building of AVI. And understand this well.
